primary_concept: Conditional on BTC's own state, test whether unusually large disagreement between BTC perpetual and BTC spot prices contains stable incremental information about subsequent BTC adverse-path risk.
verdict_reason: Both required official historical sources are unreachable from this execution host's network egress. The proxy's own diagnostics classify every attempt as a gateway-level CONNECT rejection (policy denial or upstream failure), never a response from Binance or Bybit. No archive listing, no kline payload, and no HTTP body of any kind (success or error) was received from either venue. This is a host-network-policy finding, not a claim that the historical sources themselves do not exist or are unavailable in principle.

data.binance_source: Binance Public Data / USD-M perpetual futures monthly klines archive
data.binance_price_basis_note: Mark price is explicitly NOT to be substituted for perpetual trade price in this design; not applicable to this unit since no data was retrieved.
data.quote_asset_mixing_avoided: BTC-USD spot is not mixed with BTC-USDT perpetual; no USD/USDT stablecoin basis is injected

network_probe.probe_method: curl through the session's configured egress proxy; no proxy bypass, no alternate egress path, no VPN/tunnel substitution

probes.target: Binance public-data archive index (BTCUSDT 5m USD-M futures klines prefix)
probes.proxy_diagnostic: connect_rejected: gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)

probes.target: GET /v5/market/time (connectivity probe only; no kline request attempted, no structural probe reached)
probes.proxy_diagnostic: connect_rejected: gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)

network_probe.consistent_with_prior_finding: Same connect_rejected signature previously observed for fapi.binance.com:443 and fstream.binance.com:443 during the FORWARD_MARKET_OBSERVABILITY_V1 readiness checks on this same host -- indicates a general outbound policy restriction on this execution host, not a per-endpoint anomaly.

structural_probes_performed.reason_not_performed: Structural probes require a successful connection to api.bybit.com; the connection itself was rejected at the gateway before any request could be issued or any response schema inspected.

completed_candle_semantics_note: Not determinable in this unit: no data was retrieved from either venue, so bar_start_utc/bar_end_utc mapping could not be verified against live payload schemas. Both venues' documented kline schemas are understood to support this distinction in principle, but this unit did not verify it empirically.
next_unit_note: Re-run this exact feasibility unit (unchanged concept, unchanged source route, unchanged 2022-2024 target window) from a deployment host whose network egress can reach data.binance.vision and api.bybit.com. No code or design change is implied by this blocker; only host network reachability is the open question.
